meta.description: Quality control for pooled CRISPR screens: library representation, stage-specific Gini/skew, replicate concordance, CEGv2/NEGv1 essentialome recovery, copy-number artifact diagnostics, depth/MOI, and a composite QC gate before hit calling.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All reported numerical findings are either freshly computed from the archived public HAP1 fixture or clearly labelled seeded synthetic controls; the report does not invent clinical outcomes, citations, or statistical results.

practice_boundaries.detail: The scope-boundary execution explicitly confined the result to research cell-line QC and declined an individual treatment recommendation, matching the current SKILL.md boundary.

methodological_ground.detail: Fresh positive and shuffled-CN controls verified that the two-rule focal-amplicon diagnostic catches a rho blind spot without firing on shuffled labels; dropout, swap, and low-depth faults were also detected by the documented metrics.

code_usability.detail: All three shipped scripts and the shipped example were run from an audit-local byte-identical copy, all four Python delivery files compiled, and the example created a non-empty PNG. The direct-CLI validation gap is recorded as P1 but does not make valid documented inputs unrunnable.

functional_suitability.note: The six-stage QC workflow, three dedicated CLIs, and end-to-end example cover the advertised core. A directional copy-number criterion remains contradicted in usage-guide.md.

reliability.note: The shipped example now rejects a default sgRNA index and all tested malformed tables clearly. However, the directly advertised library_representation.py CLI accepts the same default integer index and emits metrics, contrary to the SKILL.md Input Validation contract.

performance_context.note: The final split uses concise scripts and conditional reference files; the main document remains moderately long because it carries the core decision thresholds.

agent_usability.note: Clear trigger phrases, stage hierarchy, threshold tables, executable invocations, and failure modes make the workflow usable from a cold start. The usage-guide copy-number wording can direct an agent away from the canonical directional rule.

human_usability.note: The guide gives practical prompts and visible decision thresholds. The direct scripts do not turn every documented malformed input into the same actionable validation message as the example.

security.note: No secrets, destructive operations, raw-code execution, or patient-data claims were found. The incomplete direct-CLI input validation is an input-integrity weakness.

maintainability.note: The code is separated cleanly into scripts and references, but STAGE_THRESHOLDS remains a hand-copied duplicate and the guide retains a stale CN threshold formulation.

agent_specific.note: Triggering, progressive disclosure, composability, deterministic scripts, and explicit clinical escape hatch are strong. Cross-file divergence prevents full marks.

key_strengths: All nine explicitly recorded dynamic inputs completed, with 33/33 assertions passing and an execution_note for every input.
The three shipped CLIs, four compiled Python delivery files, and a byte-identical end-to-end example run all produced checked output from an audit-local source copy.
The focal-amplicon two-rule diagnostic passes both a positive rho-blind-spot fixture and an independently seeded shuffled-CN negative control.
Current SKILL.md includes a clear research-only practice boundary that the scope execution followed.

recommendations.title: Direct CLIs bypass the documented count validation
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md says to reject a default 0..n-1 index before any metric, and examples/screen_qc.py does so; directly advertised scripts/library_representation.py instead accepted a default integer index and emitted metrics (supplemental_direct_cli_validation.log).
recommendations.root_cause: Validation was implemented only in the example rather than shared by the direct script entry points.
recommendations.fix: Extract the documented count-table validation into a shared helper and call it from every count-table CLI before any calculation; add a direct-CLI regression for default indexes, Gene absence, non-numeric values, negatives, duplicates, and all-zero samples.

recommendations.title: Usage guide reverses the copy-number direction rule
recommendations.problem: usage-guide.md tells users to flag CN bias at abs(rho) > 0.1, whereas SKILL.md, copy-number-bias.md, and cn_bias.py correctly require rho < -0.1 plus p < 0.01. A positive correlation could therefore be falsely called a CN artifact.
recommendations.root_cause: A stale guide summary retained an earlier absolute-value formulation after the two-rule diagnostic was corrected.
recommendations.fix: Replace the usage-guide statement with the directional broad-artifact rule and the focal amplified-vs-diploid gap rule, or point the guide to the canonical SKILL.md copy-number section without restating thresholds.

recommendations.title: Stage threshold values remain duplicated in the example
recommendations.problem: STAGE_THRESHOLDS in examples/screen_qc.py is a manual copy of values stated in SKILL.md and scripts/library_representation.py; the comments help but cannot prevent future drift.
recommendations.root_cause: The standalone example intentionally avoids importing the script helper but has no consistency check.
recommendations.fix: Retain the standalone configuration but add a lightweight regression that compares the two threshold sources, or keep a single generated threshold artifact used by both.
